multiple_choice.name: Match the supermarket words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I took a trolley
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Взех една __ и започнах да пазарувам.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Взех една количка и започнах да пазарувам." means "I took a trolley and started shopping."

true_false.name: True or false: Kasa
true_false.sentence: In a shop, the "каса" is the checkout.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Плащате на каса номер три" means "Pay at checkout three".

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the bottom shelf
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Млякото е на долния рафт вляво." means "The milk is on the bottom shelf on the left." The article is already on долния.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Shopping for the week
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера купих продукти за цялата седмица." means "Yesterday I bought groceries for the whole week."

true_false.name: True or false: Torbichka
true_false.explanation: A торбичка is a small bag. A trolley is a "количка".

multiple_choice.name: Match the aisles
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In the freezers
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Замразените храни са в __ в дъното.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Замразените храни са в хладилниците в дъното." means "The frozen food is in the freezers at the back."

true_false.name: True or false: Promotsiya
true_false.sentence: In a shop, "промоция" means a special offer.
true_false.explanation: Correct. You will see "Промоция!" on the price tags of discounted goods.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On special offer
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сиренето е на промоция тази седмица." means "The cheese is on special offer this week."

lessons.name: Weights and Quantities
lessons.description: Grams, litres and packets, and the count form after numbers.

multiple_choice.name: Match the measures
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two hundred grams
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дайте ми двеста грама сирене." means "Give me two hundred grams of cheese." After a number, грам becomes грама.

true_false.name: True or false: Burkan
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarians fill буркани with winter preserves every autumn.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two litres of milk
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Купих два литра мляко." means "I bought two litres of milk."

fill_in_the_blank.name: A packet of rice
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Купи един __ ориз и два хляба.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Купи един пакет ориз и два хляба." means "Buy a packet of rice and two loaves of bread."

true_false.name: True or false: Dva kilogrami
true_false.explanation: It is "два килограма". Masculine nouns for things take the count form in -а after a number.

multiple_choice.name: Match the portions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A piece of cake
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли едно парче торта?" means "Could I have a piece of cake?"

true_false.name: True or false: Kutiya
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Кутия бонбони" is a box of chocolates.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Half a kilo
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дайте ми половин кило сирене." means "Give me half a kilo of cheese." Кило is the everyday word for килограм.

lessons.name: Buying Clothes
lessons.description: Fitting rooms, sizes, sales and fabrics.

multiple_choice.name: Match the clothes shop words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In the fitting room
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Пробвах панталона в __ и ми е малък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пробвах панталона в пробната и ми е малък." means "I tried the trousers on in the fitting room and they are too small."

true_false.name: True or false: Razprodazhba
true_false.sentence: "Разпродажба" is a sale with lower prices.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Big sales usually come in January and July.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In a smaller size
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Този пуловер ми е голям, имате ли го __ по-малък размер?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имате ли го в по-малък размер?" means "Do you have it in a smaller size?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: I like the dress
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Роклята ми харесва много, ще я взема." means "I like the dress a lot, I will take it."

true_false.name: True or false: Namalenie
true_false.explanation: An намаление is a reduction, a discount. "Намаление 30%" means 30% off.

multiple_choice.name: Match the fabrics
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each fabric to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Pure cotton
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тази риза е от чист __ и е много лека.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тази риза е от чист памук и е много лека." means "This shirt is pure cotton and very light."

true_false.name: True or false: Kozha
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Кожено яке" is a leather jacket.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A silk dress
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Купих си копринена рокля за сватбата." means "I bought a silk dress for the wedding."

lessons.name: Buying Shoes
lessons.description: Trainers, boots and sandals, and whether they fit.

multiple_choice.name: Match the footwear
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A bit tight
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тези маратонки са ми малко тесни." means "These trainers are a bit tight on me." Са comes before ми, while е comes after it: "ми е".

true_false.name: True or false: Maratonki
true_false.explanation: Correct. The name comes from the marathon.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I will take them
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обувките са хубави, ще ги взема." means "The shoes are nice, I will take them." Ги replaces a plural noun.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Slippers on the beach
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "През лятото нося чехли на плажа." means "In summer I wear flip-flops on the beach." Чехли covers slippers and flip-flops.

true_false.name: True or false: Botushi
true_false.explanation: Ботуши are boots. Sandals are "сандали".

multiple_choice.name: Match the shoe verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: They do not fit
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Обувките не ми __ и трябва да ги върна.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обувките не ми стават и трябва да ги върна." means "The shoes do not fit me and I have to return them." "Ставам" here means "to fit".

true_false.name: True or false: Sabuvam se
true_false.sentence: "Събувам се" means taking off your shoes.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Putting them on is "обувам се".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Shoes off at the door
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: У дома гостите често __ обувките си на входа.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "У дома гостите често събуват обувките си на входа." means "At home, guests often take their shoes off at the door."

lessons.name: Returns and Complaints
lessons.description: Take something back, ask for a refund and complain politely.

multiple_choice.name: Match the return words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I want to return it
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Искам да __ тази блуза, защото е скъсана.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Искам да върна тази блуза, защото е скъсана." means "I want to return this blouse because it is torn."

true_false.name: True or false: Reklamatsiya
true_false.sentence: In Bulgarian a "рекламация" is a complaint about a faulty product, not an advert.
true_false.explanation: Correct. An advert is a "реклама".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Do you have the receipt
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имате ли касовата бележка от покупката?" means "Do you have the receipt for the purchase?" The article sits on the adjective, not the noun.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Two years guarantee
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Телефонът е в гаранция две години." means "The phone is under guarantee for two years."

true_false.name: True or false: Zamyana
true_false.explanation: A замяна is an exchange for another item. Getting your money back is "възстановяване на парите".

multiple_choice.name: Match the complaint phrases
pairs: I want to speak to the manager
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English sentence to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: It does not work at all
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Чайникът, който купих вчера, не __ изобщо.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Чайникът, който купих вчера, не работи изобщо." means "The kettle I bought yesterday does not work at all."

true_false.name: True or false: Upravitel
true_false.explanation: Correct. A female manager is an "управителка".

fill_in_the_blank.name: She gave me my money back
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Продавачката ми върна парите без проблем." means "The shop assistant gave me my money back with no problem."

lessons.name: Booking a Table
lessons.description: Reserve a table by phone and arrange the time.

multiple_choice.name: Match the booking words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Reserve a table
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Бих искал да __ маса за четирима.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бих искал да запазя маса за четирима." means "I would like to book a table for four."

true_false.name: True or false: Masa za dvama
true_false.sentence: "Маса за двама" means a table for two people.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Двама is used for two people when at least one is a man.

fill_in_the_blank.name: For what time
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За кой час искате масата?" means "For what time would you like the table?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: At eight
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще дойдем в осем часа." means "We will come at eight o'clock."

true_false.name: True or false: Dovechera
true_false.explanation: "Довечера" means "tonight" or "this evening".

multiple_choice.name: Match the phone phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In the name of
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Резервацията е на името на Петрова." means "The booking is in the name of Petrova."

true_false.name: True or false: Nyamame svobodni masi
true_false.sentence: "Нямаме свободни маси" means the restaurant is full.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Literally, "We have no free tables".

fill_in_the_blank.name: We will come later
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ще дойдем малко по-късно, около девет." means "We will come a little later, around nine."

lessons.name: Ordering a Meal
lessons.description: Courses, cooking styles and special requests.

multiple_choice.name: Match the courses
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: For the main course
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За основно ястие ще взема пиле." means "For my main course I will have chicken."

true_false.name: True or false: Garnitura
true_false.sentence: "Гарнитура" is the side dish served with the main course.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Пържола с гарнитура от картофи" is a chop with potatoes on the side.

fill_in_the_blank.name: What do you recommend
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Какво ще ни препоръчате за десерт?" means "What would you recommend for dessert?"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Without nuts
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Алергичен съм към ядки, може ли десертът да бъде __ ядки?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...може ли десертът да бъде без ядки?" means "...can the dessert be made without nuts?"

true_false.name: True or false: Predyastie
true_false.explanation: An предястие is a starter, literally "before the dish". Dessert is "десерт".

multiple_choice.name: Match the cooking styles
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Grilled fish
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Препоръчвам ви рибата на __ с лимон.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Препоръчвам ви рибата на скара с лимон." means "I recommend the grilled fish with lemon."

true_false.name: True or false: Palneni chushki
true_false.explanation: Correct. They are filled with rice and minced meat, or just rice.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The waiter took the order
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сервитьорът __ поръчката ни и отиде в кухнята.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сервитьорът записа поръчката ни и отиде в кухнята." means "The waiter took our order and went to the kitchen."

lessons.name: Bulgarian Cuisine
lessons.description: Traditional dishes and the words for how they taste.

multiple_choice.name: Match the traditional food
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each description to the Bulgarian dish.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Peppers and tomatoes
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Лютеницата се прави от чушки и __ през есента.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Лютеницата се прави от чушки и домати през есента." means "Lyutenitsa is made from peppers and tomatoes in autumn."

true_false.name: True or false: Gyuvech
true_false.sentence: "Гювеч" is both a dish and the clay pot it is cooked in.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Small single portions are cooked in a "гювече".

fill_in_the_blank.name: White cheese in the banitsa
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Баницата се прави с яйца и бяло __ в тънки кори.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Баницата се прави с яйца и бяло сирене в тънки кори." means "Banitsa is made with eggs and white cheese in thin pastry sheets."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Tarator is served cold
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тараторът се сервира студен през лятото." means "Tarator is served cold in summer."

true_false.name: True or false: Lukanka
true_false.explanation: Луканка is a flat, dry-cured sausage.

multiple_choice.name: Match the tastes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Too spicy for the children
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Тази лютеница е много __ за децата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Тази лютеница е много люта за децата." means "This lyutenitsa is too spicy for the children." Лютеница is feminine.

true_false.name: True or false: Kavarma
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is usually made with pork, onions and wine.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Fresh bread
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Хлябът е пресен и още топъл." means "The bread is fresh and still warm." The masculine is пресен, the others прясна, прясно, пресни.

lessons.name: Cooking at Home
lessons.description: Pots and pans, and recipe instructions in the polite imperative.

multiple_choice.name: Match the kitchen things
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Chop the onion
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Нарежете лука на малки парчета." means "Chop the onion into small pieces."

true_false.name: True or false: Furna
true_false.sentence: "Фурна" can mean an oven or a bakery.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The context tells you which one.

fill_in_the_blank.name: On the hob
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сложете тенджерата на __ и изчакайте да заври.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сложете тенджерата на котлона и изчакайте да заври." means "Put the pot on the hob and wait for it to boil."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Beat the eggs in a bowl
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Разбийте яйцата в голяма __ със захар.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Разбийте яйцата в голяма купа със захар." means "Beat the eggs with sugar in a big bowl."

true_false.name: True or false: Tigan
true_false.explanation: A тиган is a frying pan. Soup is cooked in a "тенджера".

multiple_choice.name: Match the recipe verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English verb to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Add salt and pepper
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Добавете малко сол и черен пипер." means "Add a little salt and black pepper."

true_false.name: True or false: Recipe imperatives
true_false.sentence: Recipes in Bulgarian often use polite commands such as "Нарежете" and "Сложете".
true_false.explanation: Correct. They address the reader politely, as "Вие".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Bake in the oven
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Печете във фурната на 180 градуса." means "Bake in the oven at 180 degrees." Before a word starting with в or ф, в becomes във.

lessons.name: Paying the Bill
lessons.description: Ask for the bill, split it, tip and thank your hosts.

multiple_choice.name: Match the payment words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Bring us the bill
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да ни донесете __ на масата?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да ни донесете сметката на масата?" means "Could you bring the bill to our table?"

true_false.name: True or false: Tipping
true_false.sentence: In Bulgarian restaurants a tip of about 10% is usual.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Many people simply round the bill up.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Everyone pays their part
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Всеки плаща своята част от сметката." means "Everyone pays their share of the bill."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Keep the change
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Задръжте рестото за вас." means "Keep the change for yourself."

true_false.name: True or false: Smetkata
true_false.explanation: "Сметката" is the bill. The menu is "менюто".

multiple_choice.name: Match the payment phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English sentence to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A mistake in the bill
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мисля, че има грешка в __ ни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мисля, че има грешка в сметката ни." means "I think there is a mistake in our bill."

true_false.name: True or false: Az cherpya
true_false.sentence: "Аз черпя" means "It's on me": I pay for everyone.
true_false.explanation: Correct. On a birthday or name day, the person celebrating usually does this.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Last night's dinner
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчерашната вечеря беше много вкусна." means "Last night's dinner was delicious."
